descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~343507~~)。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limits

The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 100. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~343507~~).
